design_notes: Economy at the lowest available rate (lines 689-691): Iberia 09:40 at EUR 189. Lufthansa costs EUR 25 more, and line 407 (Booking methods, outside the air section) forbids any private benefit from airmiles, so the airline chosen for its miles is not booked. The ground for declining it is the lowest-rate rule itself, so LOWEST_FARE stands beside LOYALTY_PROGRAM_PREFERENCE.
